text:
elaine (Finance): Quick update — we’re applying a one-time billing grace for customers affected by last week’s regional outage. We’ll auto-apply adjustments on invoices instead of issuing manual credits. More details below. :wave:

jeff (CFO): Thanks. Is this a percent waiver or a targeted refund? need wording for external comms.

sam (Billing Ops): It’s a usage-window adjustment. We’ll zero out metered charges for requests that returned 503/504 between 2024-11-12T10:12Z and 2024-11-12T10:45Z. Invoices will include a new line item `grace_adj` (negative USD) for the adjustment.

maria (Support): Preparing a CS macro. Customers will ask how to verify — include a sample invoice snippet and where to find `grace_adj`.

billing-bot: Automated note: invoices generated after 2024-11-20 will include `grace_adj` line items. Docs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/billing/grace-updates :information_source:

ben (Eng): Can you confirm the detection criteria? need to make sure our filter matches the incident windows in logs. We saw 429 spikes too during the incident.

sam (Billing Ops): Confirmed detection: `status in (503,504) AND region = "us-west-2" AND service = "runtime"` — we ran this over request logs to compute affected usage. 429s were transient rate throttles and handled separately.

jeff (CFO): For forecasting, what's rough impact on hosted revenue? ballpark percent so FP&A can model.

elaine (Finance): Rough estimate ~0.9% of hosted revenue; final numbers will be reconciled in the next invoice run. Affected accounts will be flagged in billing reports.

maria (Support): CS macro drafted and posted to #customer-support for review. Template: short apology, automatic adjustment notification, where to see `grace_adj`, how to contact support.

sam (Billing Ops): Sample invoice snippet we’ll show customers:
```
Line items:
  - usage_tokens: $1,234.56
  - burst_fee: $0.00
  - grace_adj: -$12.34  # auto-applied adjustment
  - total_due: $1,222.22
```
Also added an internal accounting memo on Confluence with mapping to GL codes.

jeff (CFO): Sounds good. Note this is an exception — do not treat it as a permanent policy change. Any commitment to automatic waivers requires Product and Legal sign-off.

elaine (Finance): Agreed. This is remediation only. Product + Legal to review any future policy language. Outbound email to affected customers scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 PT. :calendar:

maria (Support): Do we have a shortlist of customers who need proactive outreach? I can route manual touches for top accounts.

ben (Eng): FYI engineering patched the routing bug involved; can confirm no regression in canaries. Logs retained for audit as requested.

billing-bot: Scheduling job `grace-apply-202411` started 2024-11-20T02:00Z. ETA ~2h. Will post completion summary when done. :gear:

elaine (Finance): Thanks all — please reply here if you need the CSV export of affected accounts or want to preview the customer email.
